subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

During the preparation for competitive exams, Meena __avoided__ going to parties.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"avoided"** means to stay away from someone or something deliberately. (से बचना)

 
 
• **Example:** She** avoided** the busy streets during rush hour.
 
 
 
• **"Steered clear of"** is a synonym for "avoided" and means to deliberately avoid someone or something. (से दूर रहना)
 
 
• **Example:** He **steered clear of **the argument to avoid any confrontation.
 
 

Hence, the phrase **"steered clear of"** is the most appropriate substitution for "avoided" in the given sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cracked a joke** (मजाक किया): To tell a joke or make a witty remark.

 
 
• **Example:** He **cracked a joke** to lighten the mood during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Fired a cracker** (पटाखा जलाया): To set off a firecracker.
 
 
• **Example:** They **fired a cracker** to celebrate the festival.
 
 
 
• **Whispered a secret** (राज़ बताया): To quietly tell someone a secret.
 
 
• **Example:** She **whispered a secret** to her friend during the class.
